title: Delete or rewrite bulk_prior_completion_b6_b8_test.dart's stale AC3 test now that supersededAt was dropped

evidence.quote: // W3.29 dropped `supersededAt`. The helper still inserts 3 stages (2

why: AC3 (lines 325-397) and its helper _seedStagesWithSuperseded (lines 216-239) were written to prove superseded stages are excluded from bulk-mark-prior. W3.29 removed the supersededAt column entirely, so the helper can no longer create a 'superseded' row, and the test's own comment admits 'the only 2 active expectation was outdated' — it now just re-proves AC1's '3 stages => 3 completions' with extra indirection. The test still reads as coverage for supersession filtering to anyone skimming the group, which is misleading, and the dead helper is pure maintenance cost.
recommendation: Remove AC3 and _seedStagesWithSuperseded (their coverage is already fully subsumed by AC1), or repurpose the test name/comment to state plainly it is a duplicate-of-AC1 regression check for the schema migration itself.
acceptance_criteria: no test or helper in this file references a superseded-stage scenario that the current schema (no supersededAt column) cannot represent
